##: The green/portable ZIP is a flat launcher tree with Cube.exe at the root; the accompanying CubeSetup.exe is a real GUI installer, so the portable ZIP is packaged instead.
The vendor exposes no working JSON endpoint for downloads (the JSONP URL on cubeDownload.html returns 502), so checkver reads the version from the portable filename on the official download page.
Cube.exe is a 32-bit bootstrapper, but the vendor states Windows 7 64-bit or later and the bundled Electron UI is 64-bit; a single top-level url/hash therefore covers the only supported architecture.
The vendor publishes no checksum, so autoupdate.hash is omitted and Scoop recomputes SHA-256 by downloading the ZIP on version bumps.
Login state and settings are written under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Cube and Electron's userData under %APPDATA%, not into the app directory, so no persist entry is needed.
description: Cube Game platform client for buying, downloading and launching PC games
notes: Requires Windows 7 64-bit or later. Game files and account data live outside the Scoop app directory.
